text: Garlic and onions are commonly utilized in culinary applications as a distinct spice blend. They can be sautéed in tandem, combined with other ingredients to produce a delectable meal, or employed as a garnish. When preparing garlic, it is necessary to grate or chop finely, and added to hot foods to intensify their flavor. In contrast, onions can be incorporated in moderation, chopped finely, or sliced thinly, contingent upon the dish and personal taste.
